title: Law to study vacant rent-stabilized apartments
summary: This bill would require the Department of Housing Preservation and Development to analyze why rent-stabilized apartments sit vacant citywide and develop a plan to return them to the rental market. The analysis must examine factors like renovation costs, habitability standards, financial incentives and building conditions. HPD would need to submit the analysis and plan to the Council speaker and mayor, and post it online, within 60 days of the law taking effect.
